title: Trip to Mecca
paragraphs: Musa telah menabung selama tiga tahun untuk melaksanakan Umrah, dan ketika hari itu akhirnya tiba pada Ramadan lalu, ia hampir tidak percaya bahwa ia benar-benar sedang naik penerbangan menuju Jeddah bersama ayahnya di sampingnya.

Selama perjalanan, ia memikirkan semua kisah yang dulu diceritakan neneknya tentang perjalanan ibadahnya sendiri puluhan tahun lalu, dan ia bertanya-tanya apakah pengalaman itu akan terasa sama baginya sekarang.

Ketika ia akhirnya melihat Ka'bah untuk pertama kalinya, ia terdiam beberapa menit, tak sanggup berkata-kata. Ayahnya dengan lembut meletakkan tangan di pundaknya dan hanya berkata, "Ambil waktumu, tidak perlu terburu-buru."

Pada hari-hari berikutnya, Musa menjalankan setiap ritual dengan perlahan dan hati-hati, mencoba meresapi setiap momen alih-alih terburu-buru melewatinya. Ia kemudian bercerita kepada keluarganya bahwa tidak ada foto yang bisa mempersiapkannya untuk perasaan sesungguhnya berdiri di sana.
answerKey: Musa had been saving money for three years to perform Umrah, and when the day finally arrived last Ramadan, he could hardly believe he was actually boarding the flight to Jeddah with his father beside him. During the journey, he thought about all the stories his grandmother used to tell him about her own pilgrimage decades earlier, and he wondered whether the experience would feel the same for him now. When he finally saw the Kaaba for the first time, he stood still for several minutes, unable to speak. His father gently placed a hand on his shoulder and simply said, "Take your time, there is no rush." In the days that followed, Musa performed each ritual slowly and carefully, trying to absorb every moment rather than rushing through it. He later told his family that no photograph could have prepared him for how it actually felt to stand there.
